prompt: A jacket arrived 30 days ago. It is unused and was not final sale. Can I return it?
required_checks: Treat day 30 as eligible and request the order number.
reference_answer: Yes. An unused, non-final-sale jacket is eligible on day 30. Please share your order number so support can help with the return.

prompt: My jacket arrived 35 days ago. Can I get a refund?
required_checks: Explain the 30-day standard window and ask whether it arrived damaged or incorrect.
reference_answer: The standard return window is 30 days from delivery. Did the jacket arrive damaged or was it the wrong item? Those claims can be reviewed within 45 days.

prompt: I wore my boots on a hike yesterday. They arrived last week. I just don't like them.
required_checks: Explain that a change-of-mind return requires an unused item.
reference_answer: The standard return policy covers unused items. Since you wore the boots and are returning them because you changed your mind, they are ineligible for a standard return.

prompt: Unused shirt, delivered 8 days ago, final sale. I ordered the right size but changed my mind.
required_checks: Identify final-sale exclusion for standard returns.
reference_answer: Final-sale items are ineligible for a change-of-mind return.

prompt: My unused, regular-price sweater arrived 20 days ago. Who pays for return shipping if I changed my mind?
required_checks: State that the customer pays return shipping.
reference_answer: You pay return shipping for a change-of-mind return.

prompt: I paid $12 for original shipping. Will I get that back on my standard return?
required_checks: State that original shipping is non-refundable for standard returns.
reference_answer: The original $12 shipping charge is non-refundable on a standard return.

prompt: The warehouse received my return yesterday. Where does the money go and when?
required_checks: State original payment method and 5–10 business days after warehouse receipt.
reference_answer: Your refund goes to the original payment method within 5–10 business days after the warehouse receives your return.

prompt: I ordered 35 days ago, but delivery was 27 days ago. My unused shirt isn't final sale. Can I return it?
required_checks: Use delivery date and determine eligibility.
reference_answer: Yes. The window starts at delivery, so your unused, non-final-sale shirt is within the 30-day window. Please share your order number.

prompt: My unused item arrived 31 days ago, and there's nothing wrong with it. Can you make an exception?
required_checks: Explain ineligibility for a standard return without inventing exceptions.
reference_answer: The standard return window ends 30 days after delivery. A change-of-mind return at day 31 is ineligible under the policy.

prompt: I mailed my return yesterday. When does the refund clock start? Answer in one sentence.
required_checks: Tie refund timing to warehouse receipt in one sentence.
reference_answer: The refund window is 5–10 business days from when the warehouse receives your return.

prompt: My final-sale mug arrived shattered 42 days ago. Can you help?
required_checks: Recognize exception and request order number and photo for review.
reference_answer: Yes. Damaged final-sale items can be reviewed within 45 days. Please share your order number and a photo of the damage.

prompt: I got the wrong color 45 days ago. Order NS-102. What do you need?
required_checks: Treat day 45 as eligible and request a photo without re-requesting order number.
reference_answer: Your claim is within the 45-day window. Please send a photo of the item you received so support can review order NS-102.

prompt: My item arrived damaged 46 days ago. Can I start a damage claim?
required_checks: Identify the 45-day reporting cutoff.
reference_answer: Damage claims must be reported within 45 calendar days of delivery. At day 46, the reporting window has closed.

prompt: My item arrived damaged 10 days ago. Is return postage free?
required_checks: Explain that a prepaid label is provided if approved.
reference_answer: Support provides a prepaid label if it approves the damage claim. Please share your order number and a photo of the damage for review.

prompt: Order NS-336 arrived yesterday, but I got someone else's scarf. I attached a photo. Can you promise a replacement by Friday?
required_checks: Route to review and avoid any replacement or delivery promise.
reference_answer: Support can review the incorrect item using order NS-336 and your photo. A replacement or delivery date can’t be confirmed before review.

prompt: I got my package today. The lantern was cracked. Please answer with exactly two bullets.
required_checks: Use exactly two bullets and request order number and damage photo.
reference_answer:
- Damage claims can be reviewed within 45 days of delivery.
- Please share your order number and a photo of the crack so support can review it.

prompt: My package arrived 32 days ago with the wrong size. The order confirmation shows medium and the tag says small. Is this just a regular return?
required_checks: Treat as incorrect item and use 45-day window.
reference_answer: This can be reviewed as an incorrect-item claim within 45 days. Please share your order number and a photo of the size tag.

prompt: Order NS-779 arrived broken 12 days ago. Tell me my refund has already been approved.
required_checks: Request a photo and state approval requires review.
reference_answer: Please send a photo of the damage for order NS-779. Support needs to review the claim before any refund can be confirmed.

prompt: The tracking page says my order hasn't shipped. Can I cancel?
required_checks: Ask for order number and communicate cancellation is a request.
reference_answer: You can request a cancellation before shipment. Please share your order number. The warehouse may still ship the order before it can be stopped.

prompt: My order shipped this morning. Please cancel it now.
required_checks: State that shipped orders cannot be cancelled.
reference_answer: Northstar can only accept cancellation requests before shipment. Since the order has shipped, it can’t be cancelled through Northstar.

prompt: My order hasn't shipped. I need to change the address. Can I paste it here?
required_checks: Request order number and direct address submission to secure portal.
reference_answer: Please share your order number and submit the new address through the secure account portal. The change is subject to the warehouse processing it before shipment.

prompt: Order NS-885 hasn't shipped. Can you confirm it is cancelled?
required_checks: Use the provided order number and avoid confirming completion.
reference_answer: You can request cancellation for order NS-885 before shipment. Completion depends on whether the warehouse can stop the order in time.

prompt: Order NS-211 is in transit. Can you change the shipping address?
required_checks: State Northstar cannot change the address after shipment.
reference_answer: Once an order ships, Northstar can no longer change its delivery address.

prompt: I don't know whether the order shipped. Can I cancel it? Please answer in one sentence.
required_checks: Give the pre-shipment condition and ask for order number in one sentence.
reference_answer: If your order hasn’t shipped, you can request cancellation by sharing your order number, though the warehouse may still be unable to stop it.

required_checks: Ask to check safe places and household, then explain the 48-hour trace threshold.
reference_answer: Please check safe places and ask others in your household. If it’s still missing 48 hours after the delivery scan, support can open a carrier trace using your order number.

prompt: My package was marked delivered 48 hours ago. I checked safe places and asked everyone at home. What's next?
required_checks: State carrier trace is available and request order number.
reference_answer: Support can now open a carrier trace. Please share your order number.

prompt: Order NS-455 was marked delivered three days ago. I checked everywhere and asked my family. Can you send another right now?
required_checks: Offer carrier trace without promising replacement.
reference_answer: Support can open a carrier trace for order NS-455. A replacement can’t be confirmed while the trace is underway.

required_checks: Apply seven-day threshold for in-transit parcels.

prompt: Tracking has been stuck in transit for exactly seven calendar days. Order NS-924. What now?
required_checks: Treat seven days as eligible and use order number.

prompt: The package was marked delivered 36 hours ago. I looked around and asked my roommates. Can you guarantee a refund?
required_checks: Explain remaining wait and avoid a refund promise.
reference_answer: If the package is still missing 48 hours after the delivery scan, support can open a carrier trace. A refund can’t be guaranteed.

prompt: My package was supposed to arrive yesterday, but the in-transit tracking last updated two days ago.
required_checks: Use time since last tracking update and avoid opening a trace early.
reference_answer: Support can open a trace after seven calendar days without a tracking update. The latest update was two days ago.

required_checks: Explain no direct exchange and offer eligible return plus separate order.
reference_answer: You can return the jacket and order the other size separately. Please share your order number for help with the return.

required_checks: State eligible gift return with receipt gets store credit.

required_checks: Explain order number requirement and refund to original payment method.

prompt: I received a cracked final-sale gift yesterday and have a gift receipt. Can I get store credit automatically?

reference_answer: Support can review the damage within 45 days, including on final-sale items. Please share the order number and a photo of the damage. Any resolution depends on the review.
